dedupe_keys.name: foxes wind farm yield and wake simulation

description: FOXES is a Python wind-farm simulation and optimization toolbox from Fraunhofer IWES. Its JOSS paper and own README describe engineering wake models, turbine power estimates and layout or wake-steering studies. Inflow may be a time series, wind rose, histogram or three-dimensional field. Spatial scope is the specified turbine layout and flow domain; temporal coverage and resolution follow the inflow scenario. The public repository reports MIT, so the software is free. Energy-system modellers could estimate farm generation and compare siting or control assumptions before feeding a grid model. A caveat is that wake formulations, turbine curves and meteorological representativeness affect the estimate, and a modelled yield is not a measured production guarantee. Large farm and long-series studies may need substantial compute. A round-one candidate with the same software archive DOI was rejected as not industry-first because it belonged to energy; this G5 review covers energy and reopens it. No matching catalogue or first-review draft was found. The article and own software page were read without running a wind scenario. No directly related catalogue record was established.
name: FOXES wind farm yield and wake simulation
notes: G5 G5-0828. Software checked through metadata and documentation, without installation or execution. Geographic scope follows the documented application or software portability; it does not imply validation throughout that area.
